previous_blocking_resolution.B1: resolved: telegram.BotNotFoundError is produced by Repo.SearchPublicChat for the TDLib ResponseError value with code 400 and message 'Username not found', the error is wrapped with %w, and transport maps it through errors.As to codes.NotFound.
previous_blocking_resolution.B2: resolved: FloodWaitFromError is now applied to all TDLib wrappers reached by the five new RPCs: SearchPublicChat/GetUser/GetUserFullInfo, GetMessage/GetChatHistory, GetCallbackQueryAnswer, and SendMessage/SendBotStartMessage. Non-429 errors pass through as the same wrapped error value. SendMessageAndWait derives its retry delay from FloodWaitError and retains the prior retry-wait behavior.
previous_blocking_resolution.B3: resolved: the handler starts the blocking facade call in a goroutine and selects over a buffered result channel and the 10s context. The result branch prioritizes DeadlineExceeded/Canceled over a late result; the Done branch returns the same status immediately. The buffered channel prevents the producer from blocking after the handler returns, and go-tdlib's own 60s catch timeout bounds the background call.
previous_blocking_resolution.B4: resolved: facade.Service.GetBotInfo rejects nil UserFullInfo or nil BotInfo with TargetNotBotError before transport conversion, so the handler maps it to FailedPrecondition. Facade and transport negative tests cover the path.

fix_boundary_check.B1: the typed error is defined in infra and mapped at transport; no app-layer TDLib parsing was introduced.
fix_boundary_check.B2: non-429 existing-path errors retain identity because FloodWaitFromError returns the original error when no retry-after pattern is present. The warmup 429 assertion is intentionally strengthened to require FloodWaitError while retaining the strict no-LoadChats/no-retry checks and call-count assertion. sendMessageAndWaitOnce still returns the parsed wait and retries according to the existing loop.
fix_boundary_check.B3: no channel leak is present: exactly one buffered send is made, the result channel is buffered to capacity one, and cancel is deferred. The callback virtual-time test plus the race run found no data race. The goroutine can outlive the handler only until go-tdlib's bounded catch timeout; it returns to the buffered channel without blocking.
fix_boundary_check.B4: the non-bot decision happens in facade before the transport DTO is produced, preserving the established typed-error boundary and leaving the success mapper unchanged.
